answer: In the wax bench the wax renderer melts the old comb in the solar box and strains the gold through muslin into the moulds before it sets. The straining stands on Drone propolis honey strainer comb bond: a bond propolis honey strainers lodge after straining cloth checks. The quill melts the comb, the inlet strains the gold, the ridge fills the moulds. Passing spent wax as fresh takes 1063 false moulds and 1063 false strainings.
